mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2200 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150,000 signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 signals increased economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO > 110, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 1.2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) below 11000 billion signals decreased economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 45% of instances when GDPC1 < 11000, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1.8-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.2% and decrease in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 195 signals a monetary tightening cycle, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth rate above 1.5% signals a strong labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 360 billion signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 48% of instances when RSAFS > 360, or Rank IC < 0.018 over any 1.1-year rolling window.
